decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to a target range of 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed adjusted its benchmark interest rate lower to support ongoing economic goals.

changes.quote: In considering the extent and timing of additional adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate, the Committee will carefully assess incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks.
changes.explanation: The Fed added language highlighting that it will carefully weigh the timing and size of any future rate moves.

changes.quote: Voting against the action was Beth M. Hammack, who preferred to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/2 to 4-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: One policymaker dissented from the decision, preferring to keep the interest rate unchanged at the higher range.

tone_quotes.quote: Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace.
Since earlier in the year, labor market conditions have generally eased, and the unemployment rate has moved up but remains low.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 21.76% APR, a 25 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.5% and moved +10 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.69% would rise by about $19.93 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 4.2%, and employers added an average of 107k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.7% over the past year (November 2024); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.9%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 3.2% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved +10 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved -2.95%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.11% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that future rate adjustments will depend on incoming economic data and the evolving outlook.
